title: evidence-closed-loop: reference implementation for "Evidence-coupled bistability converts dependency structure into a recovery geometry"
description: Reference implementation for the manuscript Evidence-coupled bistability converts dependency structure into a recovery geometry (H. Saito). A single Python script verifies every theorem and proposition reported in the manuscript, prints each quoted value beside its computed value, and regenerates every display item (Tables 1 to 3, Figures 1 and 2, and the supplementary figure). Run python evidence_closed_loop.py; the run ends with all quoted values reproduced.

creators.name: Saito, Hiroki
